_comment: Researched 2026-11-19. Release: November 9, 2022 on PS4 and PS5 (Santa Monica Studio / Sony); PC on September 19, 2024 (Kotaku, PlayStation Blog). The free Valhalla DLC came out December 12, 2023 on PS4/PS5 (PlayStation Blog) and is included in the PC version; it is covered in this file. Names from the story as covered by Wikipedia and the God of War wiki: Kratos, Atreus (Loki), Freya, Odin, Thor, Tyr (and Odin disguised as him), Mimir, Brok, Sindri, Angrboda, Thrud, Heimdall, Fenrir, Garm, Surtr and Sinmara, Hel, Faye, Ratatoskr, Hildisvini, Freyr, Jormungandr, Valkyrie Queen Gna, Ragnarok itself; Valhalla DLC: Tyr and Kratos's Greek past. Weapons: Leviathan Axe, Blades of Chaos, Draupnir Spear. Voice cast: Christopher Judge (Kratos), Sunny Suljic (Atreus), Richard Schiff (Odin), Ryan Hurst (Thor), Danielle Bisutti (Freya), Laya DeLeon Hayes (Angrboda), Alastair Duncan (Mimir). Weak words: every Norse-mythology name and realm (Odin, Thor, Loki, Freya, Freyr, Tyr, Heimdall, Baldur, Fenrir, Mimir, Hel, Jormungandr, Ragnarok, Valhalla, Midgard, Asgard, Vanaheim, Alfheim, Jotunheim, Muspelheim, Helheim, Niflheim, Svartalfheim, Yggdrasil...) because they are also Marvel, mythology, Assassin's Creed Valhalla and band words; Brok, Sindri, Gna, Thrud, Garm, Surtr, Sinmara and Ratatoskr are mythology names too. Faye is a first name. 'God of War' alone is weak: it is also the 2018 game, the older Greek games and the announced spin-offs. Every voice actor is weak. Kratos and Atreus stay strong: online they almost always mean these characters. Accounts: @SonySantaMonica (the studio's account; it posts about the God of War series, including newer spin-offs, so posts about those may be covered). @PlayStation is left out. Handle from coverage; verified status not checked live. Trimmed 2026-11-19 by the main session: removed very common first names, real cities, Marvel/mythology overlaps and famous actors (Thor, Odin, Loki, Hel, Valhalla, Midgard, Asgard, Ragnarok, Ragnarök), and generic backup words, so ordinary posts are not covered.
name: God of War Ragnarök
